summary: Walks the tag list on this (element count at this+0x1C, pointer array at this+0x20 with 4-byte stride) and, for every element object whose tag field at element+4 differs from a2, overwrites that tag with a2 and calls UIFocusChange with the element's UI handle (element+32) and 1. Returns the element count. Per-frame path, invoked by SpriteGridRender (004BE4E0).

local_names.this: container holding the tag-list count (this+0x1C) and the object pointer array (this+0x20)
local_names.a2: new tag value applied to each mismatching element
local_names.v8: current element object whose tag at +4 and UI handle at +32 are touched
local_names.i: loop index over the pointer array
local_names.result: element count at this+0x1C, used as loop bound and returned

operations.description: Reads the array element count from this+0x1C into the loop bound
Iterates once per element over the pointer array at this+0x20 (4-byte stride), bound by the count at this+0x1C
Dereferences the current slot to obtain the element object pointer v8 = *(this+0x20 + 4*i)
Element is updated only when its tag at v8+4 differs from a2; the accompanying !(v10|v11) term is an uninitialized x87 flag artifact, treated as an always-true decompilation residue
Writes the new tag value a2 into the element field at v8+4
UIFocusChange invoked with the element UI handle at v8+32 and constant 1 to switch the focus state
Returns the element count held in this+0x1C
Invoked on the frame path by SpriteGridRender (004BE4E0) to refresh the proximity tags

unresolved: Guard term !(v10|v11) reads two uninitialized registers (decompilation artifact of x87 status flags); the effective condition is only element[1] != a2
Parameters a3, a4, a5 are declared but never referenced in the body
Element object layout (tag at +4, UI handle at +32) is only reachable through the element pointer; the element type is not defined in this packet
